title: HR Policy 6008 - Nurse Hiring
chunks: ST. MARY'S HOME HUMAN RESOURCES Employment Regulation Cross Reference: Policy # 6008 Page 1 of 2 (Licensing regs etc.) Approved: Subject: NURSE HIRING | ea oee ~ a han Issued: April 2007 IRevised: Aug.2023, Oct. 2025, March 2026 PURPOSE: To ensure that St Mary’s Home hires the most qualified candidates for nursing positions. Definitions: HR- Human Resources DON - Director of Nursing CEO- Chief Executive Officer OIG — Office of the Inspector General PROCEDURES: 1. HR will consult with the DON prior to posting a job opening. 2. The requirements and the profile of an ideal candidate will be obtained by HR. 3. The hiring strategy will be set during this meeting and include appropriate times for interviews and interviewers. Personnel Requisitions: 1. Requisitions must be initiated by the DON, approved by the CEO/CFO and then forwarded to the Human Resource (HR) department. 2. Personnel requisitions may come through email. 3. Requisitions should indicate the following: e Position title. e Position hours/shifts. e Exempt or nonexempt status of the position. » Reason for the opening. (New Opening or Replacement) e Changes with essential job functions and qualifications (or a current job description may be attached if necessary). Job postings: 1. HR will create job postings that briefly describe the job opening and communicate St. Mary's Home expectations. 2. Alt job openings will be posted concurrently on the employee display monitors and externally with sources appropriate for the position being filled. 3. Jobs will remain posted until the position is filled. 4. The HR department will be responsible for tracking all applicants and retaining applications, resumes and licenses as required. 5. Current employees with a satisfactory employment status may apply for intemal job openings. The consents of the employee’s manager and the HR department may be necessary. 6. All applicants for a posted vacancy will be considered based on their qualifications and ability to perform the job successfully. 7. Internal candidates who are not selected will be notified by the HR department. Interview process: 1. The HR department will screen applications and resumes prior to scheduling interviews. Initial applicant screenings are generally conducted by the HR department and then scheduled for a personal interview with the DON or their designee. 2. The HR department will schedule the interview and provide an electronic version of the application and verification of the nursing license attached to the Outlook invite. 3. The DON or designee will conduct a second screening. 4, Applicants who are pending their Authorization to Test/ Authorization to Practice letter may be scheduled for an interview. A paper copy of the application may be requested at any time. 5. All applications, notes and resumes are to be retumed to the HR office post interview. 6. Observations will be scheduled postinterview as needed under the direction of the DON. 7. The HR department will notify applicants who are not selected for positions that have been interviewed. Job offers: 1. Aftera decision has been made to hire a candidate, HR will make an

office post interview. 6. Observations will be scheduled postinterview as needed under the direction of the DON. 7. The HR department will notify applicants who are not selected for positions that have been interviewed. Job offers: 1. Aftera decision has been made to hire a candidate, HR will make an offer contingent on the satisfactory completion of a valid nursing license or Authorization to Practice/ Authorization to Test letter from the Virginia Department of Health and a review of the OIG verification list. 2. Once the HR department receives satisfactory results from all required licenses and tests or the candidate provides their Authorization to Test/ Authorization to Practice letter, nursing transcript, and proof of test date, candidates will be provided with a final confirmation of a job offer and start date. If a candidate fails to accept an offer of empioyment within 7 calendar days, the offer may be rescinded by the St. Mary’s Home. Onboarding: 1. Once a candidate has accepted a position, HR will schedule an appointment to complete the Background check, Drug Screen, Personnel sign offs and to review/obtain a copy of their valid nursing license or the Authorization to Test/ Authorization to Practice letter. 2. Candidates who are unable to provide license confirmation or their Authorization to Test/ Authorization to Practice letter along with their nursing transcript and proof of test date, will not be permitted to continue with the onboarding procedure. Reference checks: 41. HR will conduct professional reference checks and employment verifications. 2|Page
